column1: ## Read by all agents at spawn when writing to KB.tsv
##   1. Use NETWORK_GROUP for the Group field in KB.tsv. Pick the closest match.
##   2. If no match exists, propose a new term in mail/outbox → PROME. Use it provisionally.
##   4. Entity field: use CANONICAL_ENTITY where one exists. Free text otherwise but keep it short.
##   5. Source field: use SOURCE_TAG abbreviations where possible, followed by date.
